**Analyzing Interface Structures**

I'm currently dissecting the interface structures across three distinct views: the customer catalog, the inventory/dashboard admin, and the sales POS terminal. My focus is on identifying core elements, data flow, and potential synergies between them. Initial observations suggest some interesting parallels and divergences in how information is presented and utilized in each context. I'm noting the differences in display logic between the views and how they are used.


**Examining Visual Design Elements**

I'm now diving deep into the visual design of the catalog view. Specifically, I'm analyzing the left sidebar to understand its hierarchy. I'm focusing on the color choices for the active page, inactive menu items, and the call-to-action button, such as the use of Royal Blue. I'm taking notes on the font styles and weights used for the logo and menu labels. I'm also examining the icons for each menu item to understand the visual cues.


**Detailing Interface Components**

I'm now cataloging the visual components of the top navigation bar within the right sidebar, including the links and icons present. I'm noting the contrasting styles and colors used for the "Catalog" link, now the active state, as compared to "Inventory" and "Sales POS." Also, I'm examining the functionality and visual attributes of the icons, such as the Shopping Cart, Notifications, and Profile. I'm also cataloging the structure of the main content container and the design aspects of each of its elements.


**Dissecting Product Card Designs**

I'm now detailing the product card design, identifying key elements. I've noted the title, description, and prominent pricing ($249.00) with muted "Sin Stock" indicators for out-of-stock items. The action buttons, "Añadir al Carrito" and "Notificar Disponibilidad," feature distinctive styling and disabled states. I am examining the design of the "Cargar más productos" button to understand its role.

I'm now integrating pending suggestions into the appropriate views. Specifically, I'm addressing requests from Carlos Mendoza, Elena Ortiz, and Technical Support. I've reviewed item statuses—Pending, Reviewed, and Accepted. I'm focusing on "Próximos Pedidos" and cataloging the associated information within the provided structure, and then comparing the images for more ideas.

I'm now determining the best way to modify the HTML files.
